description_en: You can call the UpdateVirtualNode operation to update the properties of a virtual node
description_zh: 调用UpdateVirtualNode更新一个虚拟节点的属性
kebab_example: aliyun eci update-virtual-node --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-node-id vnd-2ze960zkdqrldeaw0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirtualNode

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual node
parameters.name: virtual_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom resources that the virtual node supports. If an ECI pod requests the custom resources, the pod is scheduled to the virtual node.
The value must be in the `resource_name=resource_count` format. Use commas (,) to separate multiple resources
parameters.name: virtual_node_name

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the cluster. Kubelet configures all containers to search for this domain name in addition to the search domain of the host
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟节点支持的自定义资源。如果ECI Pod的request中声明了相应的自定义资源，则该Pod会被调度到VNode。
格式为`资源名称=资源数量`，多个资源之间使用半角逗号间隔
parameters.name: custom_resources

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the DNS server. If the dnsPolicy of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) pod is set to `ClusterFirst`, the pod uses this IP address for the DNS service.
You can specify multiple IP addresses. Use commas (,) to separate the IP addresses
parameters.help_zh: 集群的域名。配置后，除了主机的搜索域外，Kubelet会配置所有容器来搜索该域名
parameters.name: cluster_domain

parameters.help_en: A client token that you can use to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh:
DNS服务器的IP地址。如果ECI Pod中设置了`dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst`，则使用该配置值为容器提供DNS服务。
支持配置多个IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用半角逗号间隔
parameters.name: cluster_dns

parameters.help_en: The tags for the virtual node
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The tags of the virtual node
parameters.name: tag
